specId: Extract the Marketplace view from the Specs panel so that the Specs header becomes just "Board | List", and add Marketplace as a new 6th sidebar nav item with its own route (/marketplace) and dedicated MarketplacePanel.tsx. The panel has three top-level tabs — Skills, Templates, Convention Packs — and below those tabs a full-width search bar with source-selector pills (skills.sh, GitHub Repos, Custom) that filter the left side of a horizontal split view. The left panel shows discovery results from the selected source with skill name, category badge, description preview, and an "Install" button per card; the right panel shows "Your Library (N)" — the user's installed skills with category filter pills (All, Frontend, Backend, Security, DevOps, etc.), remove buttons, and an export action. Installing a skill from the left moves it to the right; removing from the right does the inverse. The search bar auto-focuses on panel mount, searches are client-side filtered when browsing installed skills and API-driven (GET /api/skills/search?q=...&source=skills.sh) when browsing external sources. This layout solves the current problem where the skills.sh search and GitHub install UI are buried at the bottom of a 38-card scrollable list and invisible without scrolling.
